name: WPA End-to-End Institutional State Machine
name_mk: WPA институционален state machine од влез до излез
purpose: Provide one governed lifecycle for research, institutional services, educational workflows, publications, corrections and other WPA work while preserving Human Gate authority at consequential transitions.

states.name: Intake
states.output: classified request with owner, purpose and initial scope

states.name: Scope & Mandate
states.human_gate: HG1; escalate to HG2-HG4 if consequence or authority expands
states.output: bounded task specification and authority class

states.name: Source Compliance
states.output: approved source set or blocked/quarantined request

states.name: Verification
states.human_gate: required for material conflicts, high consequence or source uncertainty
states.output: verified evidence set with unresolved uncertainty visible

states.name: Analysis & Modelling
states.output: bounded analysis, draft, model or recommendation

states.name: Evidence & Safety Gate
states.human_gate: escalate on fail, uncertainty or consequential impact

states.name: Human Authorisation
states.output: approve, reject, return for revision, pause or narrow scope

states.name: Release / Application
states.human_gate: release condition inherited from prior authorisation
states.output: human-approved publication, deliverable, action or authorised institutional record

states.name: Correction & Review
states.human_gate: HG2 for material public or institutional correction; HG3-HG4 where applicable
states.output: verified correction, incident response, no-change decision or reopened task

states.name: Knowledge Reintegration
states.human_gate: no silent doctrine change; doctrine changes require HG4
states.output: verified lesson, updated research question, programme insight or governed corpus candidate

states.name: Closure
states.human_gate: required when closure creates legal, credential, financial or official institutional effect
states.output: closed audit-traceable case with reopen path

transition_rules: Every state transition must preserve case_id or equivalent trace identifier.
A transition may narrow scope automatically only within a preapproved mandate; it may not expand authority automatically.
Any move into a higher Human Gate class requires escalation before release.
A failed mandatory gate returns the case to revision, pause or blocked state; it never silently bypasses the gate.
Human approval is a state-changing event and must be attributable for HG2-HG4.
Release and application are distinct from preparation; draft completion is not institutional release.
Measured adverse outcomes may reopen a closed case.
Learning may update working knowledge only with provenance; Doctrine Kernel changes are a separate HG4 action.

cross_domain_profiles.student_lifecycle: mapped separately in /data/wpa-student-lifecycle.json; HG3 transitions remain backend-blocked until approved private infrastructure exists
